name: Reports based on Multiple UOM
query:
SELECT 
    po.name AS `Purchase Order`, 
    poi.item_code AS `Item Code`, 
    poi.item_name AS `Item Name`, 
    poi.qty AS `Ordered Quantity`, 
    uom1.name AS `UOM (Ordered)`,  -- Using the 'uom' field for ordered quantity
    poi.received_qty AS `Received Quantity`,
    uom1.name AS `UOM (Received)`,  -- Using the same 'uom' field for received quantity
    poi.qty - poi.received_qty AS `Pending Quantity`
FROM 
    `tabPurchase Order` po
JOIN 
    `tabPurchase Order Item` poi ON po.name = poi.parent
JOIN 
    `tabUOM` uom1 ON poi.uom = uom1.name   -- Join for the ordered UOM
WHERE 
    poi.qty > poi.received_qty  -- Only showing pending items
ORDER BY 
    po.name, poi.item_code;
